name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text:
Cross-department improvement: Standardize a single "source of truth" for video metadata across all teams.

Decision: The Content team owns it. They will create and maintain a shared spreadsheet with one row per video—columns for title, description, tags, publish date, and status. Every other team (Creative, Ops, Legal) must pull from this sheet, not their own files.

Trade-off: Content loses some flexibility in how they format metadata, but the whole pipeline gains speed and accuracy. No more version conflicts or last-minute scrambles when a video goes live.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s metadata spreadsheet risks becoming a stale artifact that teams ignore once the initial setup fades—soft risks like "creates a false sense of control" or "encourages lazy tagging" won’t surface until failures happen. Instead, the Content team should build a lightweight, API-connected metadata service that auto-pulls from Luma’s creative agents and pushes to downstream tools; settle the argument by proving adoption—if two teams actively use it for a month without manual overrides, the alternative wins.
